description: This file is a Perl script for generating target configuration and profile makefiles based on target metadata. It includes functions for parsing target features, names, and versions, and outputs configuration structures for a build system, likely for embedded Linux targets.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration feature strings based on provided feature list, used for defining build options.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns the full name of a target, including parent target if present.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts a version string into a standardized format used for configuration naming.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration options and metadata for a single target or subtarget.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges and deduplicates package lists, respecting negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate the full target configuration based on metadata parsing.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile metadata based on target metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and dispatches to the appropriate generator function.
